description: Six arithmetic combinations of two inputs, each result clamped to -10V to 10V

inputs.text: One of the two voltages being combined, taken as A in every operation
One of the two voltages being combined, taken as B in every operation

outputs.text: A plus B, clamped to -10V to 10V
A minus B, clamped to -10V to 10V
A multiplied by B, clamped to -10V to 10V
A divided by B, clamped to -10V to 10V
The remainder left after dividing A by B, clamped to -10V to 10V
The average of A and B, clamped to -10V to 10V
